items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: The interviewee does not mention 'Purpling' in their spoken turns; the name appears only in the interviewer's question.

ctx.x: Yeah. That beautiful tone. Tortoise shell and ivory. Yeah.

Purpling is very nice. You know, I one time I met a bass player. I wanted to ask you about... Named Thomas Mitchell. They called him Bebe. Yeah, Tom Mitchell. He was... Just talk a while. Just talk a while. That motorbike.
He was talking about Mitchell Thomas. Yeah, Bebe. Thomas Mitchell. Yeah. Thomas Mitchell.
